name: Holiness churches

citations.locator: Movements and denominations, Defining Christian Movements
citations.excerpt: Pentecostalism has roots in the 19th-century Holiness Movement, which promoted intense personal piety.
Holiness churches emerged out of the Methodist churches in the United States as they sought to restore John Wesley's teachings of personal holiness and total sanctification (perfection).

facts.value: A movement from American Methodism seeking to restore Wesley's teaching on personal holiness and total sanctification. Its churches include the Church of the Nazarene and several Church of God bodies.

Holiness bodies include the Church of the Nazarene and the various Church of God denominations.
